transferable_mechanism: Information score to prune redundant MIS candidates (catch22 selection spirit).
evidence_notes: Method for feature hygiene; not a market regime label itself.
lookahead_risks: Using future target in MI without purge
qmx_overlap: Supports catch22/entropy feature promotion discipline.
qmx_possible_gap: Formal MI-based feature prune step in GAP-0051 training.

title: Enhancing the StrategyTester to Optimize Indicators Solely on the Example of Flat and Trend Markets
author: Carl Schreiber
method_summary: Strategy Tester enhancement idea: optimize indicators separately on flat vs trend market subsets—recognizes regime-conditioned evaluation.
transferable_mechanism: Evaluate bots conditional on MIS trend/flat labels; do not optimize one knob across mixed regimes.
evidence_notes: Older tooling article; conceptual regime-split evaluation still valid.
lookahead_risks: Defining flat/trend with future-aware labels in optimizer
qmx_overlap: Supports Book/QMB conditional evaluation by regime.
qmx_possible_gap: QMB lane for regime-conditional CT-32 slices.
